name: After recital D
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
part_text: Da. whereas the political prisoner Ernesto Brieva Sempé died on 13 May 2026 in prison with grave signs of malnourishment; whereas mistreatment of political prisoners, their transfer to punishment cells, withdrawal of food from them and violent attacks on them have increased in prisons in Cuba;
